identity.name: The Journal of Arthroplasty
identity.source_note: Live guide is blocked to automated fetch (Cloudflare). source_hash is the SHA-256 of the normalized RAW Internet Archive snapshot of the official guide (web.archive.org/web/20250310170322id_/https://www.arthroplastyjournal.org/content/authorinfo, captured 2025-03-10) and is reproducible. Rules were encoded from this Internet Archive snapshot. Session C's freshness cron must use a headless fetch to re-verify the live page.

encoding_notes: Live pages are bot-protected: the ScienceDirect Guide-for-Authors is CAPTCHA-blocked with no archive snapshot, and the journal-home page is Cloudflare-protected. Rules encoded from the Internet Archive snapshot dated 2025-03-10 of https://www.arthroplastyjournal.org/content/authorinfo (the journal's official 'Guide for Authors' page). source_hash is of the live Cloudflare challenge shell, whose text is identical to other Cloudflare-gated publisher pages (hence the shared hash with AJSM).
Case Reports are explicitly NOT published by The Journal of Arthroplasty (redirected to sister journal Arthroplasty Today) -> case_report omitted from article_types.

Systematic reviews and meta-analyses must be submitted as article type 'Original Research Article' and follow the same formatting; encoded as systematic_review with original-research limits. Prospective PROSPERO registration is required and the number goes on the title page (TITLE_PAGE_ELEMENTS has no trial_registration slot -> tracked as a declaration / out-of-schema).
'Abbreviated Clinical Follow-up Reports', invited guidelines, and proceedings papers have no matching ARTICLE_TYPES enum value -> omitted. Review Articles are by invitation only.

Manuscript body limited to 3000 words (includes the 300-word abstract, excludes references). The guide allows 'No more than 10 figures OR tables' as a COMBINED total; the schema cannot express a combined cap, so figures_max=10 and tables_max=10 are both set but the true constraint is figures + tables <= 10.

line_spacing: the guide accepts '1.5 or double'; encoded 'double' (which satisfies either) -- 1.5 is also acceptable. alignment 'left' from the instruction not to justify text. Page numbers required in the lower-right corner (bottom-right). Continuous line numbering required.

Manuscript font/size is NOT specified by the guide (Times New Roman 12 is a placeholder default flagged for the author; the guide only specifies artwork fonts: Arial/Courier/Times New Roman/Symbol). page_size, margins, first_line_indent, per-level heading rules, and a running head are not specified -> null/false.

Reference style is Vancouver-style numbered: in-text numbers in SQUARE BRACKETS, reference list numbered in citation order (in_text 'bracket', order 'cited'). Journal names per the LTWA List of Title Word Abbreviations (encoded journal_abbrev 'nlm'). >6 authors -> list first 6 then 'et al.' (et_al_threshold 6). DOI use is highly encouraged (include_doi true). Note: JoA imposes no strict reference format at submission; the journal style is applied at proof stage.

Tables are placed at the END of the manuscript text (grouped_end) or uploaded as separate 'Table' files, and numbered with Arabic numerals; do not place tables or figures mid-text. Table caption position is not specified -> null.

Figures submitted as separate files: EPS/PDF (vector) or TIFF/JPEG (raster), plus MS Office native files. Resolution is tiered (halftone photos >=300 dpi, line/halftone combinations >=500 dpi, pure line drawings >=1000 dpi); min_dpi=300 encodes the lowest requirement. Captions supplied separately, not attached to the figure (figure_legends_section). Callout style 'Fig.' per the guide's appendix examples.

A 'Highlights' section and an 'Abbreviations' section are explicitly disallowed (highlights_required false). ORCID is not mentioned in the guide (orcid_required false). A cover letter is not strictly mandated; IRB approval must be noted in the cover letter OR on a separate document (cover_letter_required false).

CRediT author contributions and a competing-interests statement (provided even if none) are required. patient_consent, ethics_approval, and trial_registration are conditional (human subjects / clinical trials). scrub_metadata inferred from the 'fully blinded' manuscript requirement, not stated verbatim.

A 'Declaration of Generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process' is required as a manuscript section immediately before the References (no DECLARATION_ELEMENTS key -> out-of-schema). Acknowledgements are uploaded as a separate 'Acknowledgement Page' file, NOT on the title page or in the blinded manuscript.

Post-acceptance/workflow items noted in the guide (mandatory $100 developmental-editing fee, Elsevier Article Transfer Service, max 6 authors / writing committee) are not manuscript formatting rules and are not encoded.

Session-A consolidation (2026-07-09): supersedes any earlier note in this list that describes source_hash as a bot-challenge 'shell' hash or that records a placeholder body font/line-spacing. Authoritative current state: source_hash is reproducible per identity.source_note; font family/size and line-spacing are null wherever the live guide is silent, so the engine preserves the author's value rather than imposing a guess.
